author: Alxvvv
quote: This game is an absolute failure. most boring characters you could ever imagine. Jokes are not funny, for the first hours of the game you just do house chores. Also this girl Lucia is very rude to her boyfriend which is a disgusting behaviour. The whole game is trying to digitally castrate you. Don’t recommend, rockstar is not what it was and probably will never be again a decent company. Shame on them.
